def load3():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load3()

def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # collect diagonal lines both directions
    lines=[]
    for s in range(-(h-1),w):  # i-j = s
        lines.append([(i,i-s) for i in range(h) if 0<=i-s<w])
    for s in range(h+w-1):     # i+j = s
        lines.append([(i,s-i) for i in range(h) if 0<=s-i<w])
    for line in lines:
        # maximal runs of same non-bg color
        k=0
        while k<len(line):
            i,j=line[k]; c=g[i][j]
            if c==bg: k+=1; continue
            m=k
            while m<len(line) and g[line[m][0]][line[m][1]]==c: m+=1
            run=line[k:m]
            if len(run)>=2:
                touch=any(i in (0,h-1) or j in (0,w-1) for i,j in run)
                if not touch:
                    for di,dj in ((-1,-1),(1,1)):
                        a,b=run[0][0]+di,run[0][1]+dj if di<0 else None
                        a,b=(run[0][0]-1,run[0][1]-1) if di<0 else (run[-1][0]+1,run[-1][1]+1)
                        while 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and out[a][b]==bg:
                            out[a][b]=c; a+=di; b+=dj
            k=m
    return out
